shellCommands.command:
set -e echo "== home (empty) ==" curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -E 'Currently reading|Finished|Nothing here yet' | head -3 echo echo "== add a book (currently reading) ==" ADD=$(curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3100/books --data 'title=The Pragmatic Programmer&author=Hunt %26 Thomas¬es=Read chapter 1') LOC=$(echo "$ADD" | grep -i '^location' | sed 's/\r//') echo "redirect: $LOC" BOOK_URL=$(echo "$LOC" | sed 's/[Ll]ocation: //') BOOK_URL="http://localhost:3100${BOOK_URL#/books}" echo echo "== add a finished book ==" curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3100/books --data 'title=Atomic Habits&author=James Clear&finished=on' | grep -i '^location' echo echo "== home now lists both ==" curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -oE '
[^<]+
' echo echo "== single book page (shareable) ==" curl -s "http://localhost:3100/books/$(curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -oE '/books/[a-f0-9-]+' | head -1 | sed 's#/books/##')" | grep -oE ']*>[^<]+|
[^<]+
|id="shareurl"' | head -3 echo echo "== JSON file on disk ==" cat /tmp/books-app/books.json | head -20

set -e PRAG_ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -oE '/books/[a-f0-9-]+' | head -1 | sed 's#/books/##') echo "marking finished: $PRAG_ID" curl -s -i -X POST "http://localhost:3100/books/$PRAG_ID/finish" | grep -i '^location' echo echo "== after finish: reading vs finished counts ==" curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -oE 'class="badge[^"]*">[^<]+'

BOOKS_DATA_DIR=/tmp/books-app PORT=3101 node server.js & SERVER_PID=$! sleep 0.5 echo "== restarted server, books should still be there ==" curl -s http://localhost:3101/ | grep -oE '
[^<]+
' echo echo "== shareable single-book link still resolves ==" curl -s -o /dev/null -w "book page HTTP %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:3101/books/$(cat /tmp/books-app/books.json | grep -oE '"id": "[^"]+"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*: "//;s/"//')" kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null wait $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null echo "server stopped"
